messages:
Alex: Quick plan 2
02 Quicksilver launch: social post, 1hr webinar, 100 starter credits routing, prompt pack. Draft below. Thoughts?
Maya: Nice. Quick Q 2 are we calling it "Quicksilver Labs" or "QuickStart Labs"? Prefer shorter.
Alex: Leaning "Quicksilver Labs" to match campaign. Main asks: social copy, webinar slides, 100 starter credits routing, small prompt pack for onboarding.
Sam: Routing note 2 tagging webinar signups and granting credits via Segment. Rule preview:
```
if (signup.source == 'webinar_quicksilver' && user.tier == 'self-serve') {
  user.traits.starter_credits = 100
  analytics.track('credits.granted', {amount: 100, reason: 'quicksilver_webinar'})
}
```
Sam: Will map to SFDC and add QA checklist.
Priya: A/B test CTA copy: A "Start with 100 starter credits" vs B "Join Quicksilver Labs + get credits". Holdout 10%.
Noah: Prompt pack ready 2 3 starter templates: onboarding, search, demo prompts. Need cohort-template mapping.
Elena: Baselines: 7d activation 12%, credit redemption 18%. Goal +4pp activation lift. I'll wire dashboard & UTM breakdowns.
Maya: Draft social options:
- Short: "Join Quicksilver Labs 2 1-hr live demo + starter credits to build with Redwood. Seats limited."
- Long: "Build with Quicksilver Labs: live workshop, demo prompts, and 100 starter credits to try Redwood Inference end-to-end. Reserve your spot."
Priya: Long for LinkedIn, short for X. Add alt-text for accessibility.
Alex: Timeline: draft Mon EOD, assets Tue, landing + routing QA Wed AM, webinar Thu 16:00 PT. Who owns slides?
Noah: I'll own slides (12): latency/cost (3), prompt pack (3), demo steps (3), next steps (3). Share Tue noon.
Sam: Dry-run staging of credit flow Wed 09:00. Need 2 volunteers.
Elena: Events: onboarding.started, prompt.used, credits.granted, credits.redeemed, session.first_token. Adding to tracking doc.
Alex: Compliance: avoid 'free' in emails 2 use 'starter credits'.
Maya: Subject line variants and scrub copy.
DeployBot: scheduled_post: created for 1769000000 (2026-03-25 09:00:00 UTC) :rocket: 
Alex: Checklist: 1) social copy final, 2) landing A/B, 3) credit routing QA, 4) prompt pack live, 5) analytics dashboard. Sync Tue 11:00 PT.
Priya: I'll set up the A/B and report results in the deck.
Sam: Volunteers @Maya @Noah 2 confirm for Wed staging?
Maya: Confirmed Wed 09:15 PT.
Noah: Confirmed.
